name: self_learn
description: Continuous self-learning: archive compression summaries, background sub-agent learning, idle/interval triggers, import/export.
author: OpenSquad

idle_auto_enabled.description: Automatically start a learn run after the user is idle long enough.

idle_minutes.description: Minutes without user interaction before idle auto-learn may start.

cooldown_hours.description: Minimum hours between successful auto learn runs.

interval_hours.description: Optional wall-clock interval in hours (0 = disabled).

allow_agent_md_auto.description: Allow auto learn runs to patch agent.md (still requires evidence gate).

allow_reminder_auto.description: Allow auto learn runs to create reminders.

scheduler_tick_seconds.description: How often the idle/interval scheduler checks conditions.
